data.title: Dreveník from a bird's-eye view – aerial footage of the hillfort
data.excerpt: We have obtained bird's-eye views of the Slavic hillfort of Dreveník and are glad to share them. It is hard to understand that a hillfort of such extent receives almost no attention in the scholarly literature and that all the excavations pass it by.
data.metaTitle: Dreveník from the air – aerial views of the hillfort
data.metaDescription: Aerial footage of the extensive Slavic hillfort of Dreveník, a site that the scholarly literature and excavations pass by despite its great extent.
